answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted attestation with burn penalties. Each agent locks a bond and signs a mesa commitment binding its identity to that collateral. New identities must gather peer attestations whose weight scales with bonded stake, so a single quill cannot mint unlimited identities. A sybil swarm raising a forged signal risks slashing the bonded mesa commitments behind it, making each fake identity cost real capital rather than free registration.
